title: 第47章 当场拆穿第48章 打击报复
content_zh:
“知道了！”
赵富贵头也不回的大喊。
可是令何彩云做梦都没想到的是，赵富贵刚刚进入那个公共厕所，一个男人的声音就忽然从旁边传来。
“你叫他赵大爷？你不是他儿媳妇对不对！”
何彩云刷的扭头，就看到王洋这个市场管理员愤怒的站在自己面前。
这下子何彩云头皮发麻，甚至还有手脚冰凉的感觉。
赵富贵在厕所里拉的非常痛快，舒畅的不得了。
等到他洗完手从公共厕所里出来，就感到神清气爽，走路的时候脚底下都带风。
可就在这时，一阵女人的哭声从远处传来。
“王洋你干什么，你别碰我的鱼……你怎么可以这样，太欺负人了！”
这不正是何彩云的声音吗？
赵富贵扭头一看就发现那个叫王洋的市场管理员，竟然抱着一个大水箱准备离开。
那个大水箱里装的是最后几条青斑鱼，少说也得两百多块钱呢。
而且鱼和钱都无所谓了，看到何彩云满脸都是眼泪，赵富贵的胸口立马就腾的一声窜起一大团火焰。
“你个狗东西干什么，欺负我儿媳妇是吧？我看你是活腻歪了！”
赵富贵气冲冲的大喊道，冲过去拦在了王洋的面前。
王洋立马喝骂：“你还说她是你儿媳妇？何彩云刚刚都告诉我了，你根本不是她公公，你们只不过是一个村的而已！”
“你怎么告诉他了？”赵富贵看向何彩云。
何彩云抹着眼泪说道：“我叫你赵大爷被他听见了，他于是就知道我不是你儿媳妇……”
原来是这么回事。

不过即便如此赵富贵也没有从王洋的面前让开，毕竟何彩云是不是他儿媳妇根本不重要，王洋抢东西才是最重要的！
“你管她是不是我儿媳妇，她不是我儿媳妇你也不能抢她东西啊！你把鱼放下，然后有多远给我滚多远，否则别怪我翻脸不认人！”赵富贵撸起胳膊上的衣服袖子，毫不客气的说道。
王洋冷笑一声说道：“你知道我为什么要拿走这箱鱼吗？”
“为什么？”赵富贵问道。
王洋冷冷的说道：“因为她欠了好几次摊位费没有交！在我们这个农贸市场上摆摊卖东西，是要交摊位费的，小摊子十块，大摊子二十！”
顿了顿，王洋又说道：“她前几次来我们农贸市场摆摊，我就没和她收管理费，她今天又来摆摊，还带上你这个老不死的，既然如此那我就没有必要再跟你们客气了，你们不光要交今天的摊位费，以前欠的也得交了！”
听到王洋这番话，赵富贵立马就猜到这是怎么回事了。
何彩云前几次来农贸市场摆摊卖鱼，这个王洋肯定就已经看上她了，为了博得美人芳心，于是这个家伙就没有跟何彩云要摊位费。
今天王洋在赵富贵和何彩云这里吃了瘪，于是就彻底发怒了，这才一口气的要把所有的摊位费都收了。
何彩云不给，他于是就出手抢这一箱子鱼。
content_en:
"Got it!"
Zhao Fugui shouted without looking back.
But what He Caiyun never expected was that as soon as Zhao Fugui entered the public toilet, a man's voice suddenly came from the side.
"You call him Uncle Zhao? You are not his daughter-in-law, right?"
He Caiyun turned around and saw Wang Yang, the market manager, standing in front of him angrily.
Now He Caiyun's scalp was numb, and his hands and feet even felt cold.
Zhao Fugui had a great time defecating in the toilet and felt extremely comfortable.
When he came out of the public toilet after washing his hands, he felt refreshed and there was wind under his feet when he walked.
But at this moment, a woman's cry came from a distance.
"Wang Yang, what are you doing? Don't touch my fish... How could you do this? You're so bullying!"
Isn't this exactly He Caiyun's voice?
Zhao Fugui turned around and saw that the market manager named Wang Yang was holding a large water tank and was about to leave.
The big water tank contained the last few black grouper fish, which cost at least two hundred yuan.
And fish and money didn't matter anymore. Seeing He Caiyun's face full of tears, Zhao Fugui's chest immediately burst into flames.
"What are you doing, you piece of shit, bullying my daughter-in-law, right? I think you're tired of living!"
Zhao Fugui shouted angrily and rushed over to stop Wang Yang.
Wang Yang immediately shouted: "You still say she is your daughter-in-law? He Caiyun just told me that you are not her father-in-law at all, you are just from the same village!"
"How did you tell him?" Zhao Fugui looked at He Caiyun.
He Caiyun wiped away tears and said, "He heard me calling you Uncle Zhao, and he knew that I was not your daughter-in-law..."
So that’s what happened.
But even so, Zhao Fugui did not step away from Wang Yang. After all, it didn't matter whether He Caiyun was his daughter-in-law or not. Wang Yang's grabbing of things was the most important thing!
"You don't care whether she is my daughter-in-law or not. If she is not my daughter-in-law, you can't snatch her things! Put the fish down and roll it as far as you can for me, otherwise don't blame me for turning against you!" Zhao Fugui rolled up the sleeves on his arms and said unceremoniously.
Wang Yang sneered and said, "Do you know why I took away this box of fish?"
"Why?" Zhao Fugui asked.
Wang Yang said coldly: "Because she owed stall fees several times and failed to pay! If you set up a stall to sell things in our farmer's market, you have to pay stall fees. A small stall will cost ten yuan, and a large stall will cost twenty!"
After a pause, Wang Yang continued: "The last few times she came to set up a stall in our farmer's market, I didn't collect the management fee from her. Today she came to set up a stall again, and she brought you, an old man, with her. In this case, there is no need for me to be polite to you anymore. Not only do you have to pay today's stall fee, but you also have to pay what you owed before!"
After hearing Wang Yang's words, Zhao Fugui immediately guessed what was going on.
He Caiyun came to the farmer's market to sell fish at a stall a few times before. Wang Yang must have fallen in love with her. In order to win the beauty's heart, this guy didn't ask for stall fees from He Caiyun.
Today, Wang Yang was frustrated by Zhao Fugui and He Caiyun, so he became completely angry, and then he wanted to collect all the stall fees in one go.
He Caiyun refused to give it, so he grabbed the box of fish.
